# Chat Modes

This directory contains custom chat mode configurations for AI assistants.

## Files

- **chatmodes.md** - Chat mode definitions and usage guidelines

## Purpose

Chat modes provide context-specific AI assistance for:

- Block plugin development
- Block component creation
- WordPress block coding standards
- Block troubleshooting and debugging

## Usage

Chat modes are automatically recognized by compatible AI development tools and provide specialized assistance based on the block development context.
